path = "Sage/Dashboard/DashboardView+Schedules.swift"
lines = open\(path\).read\(\).split\("\\n"\)

    if not ln.strip\(\):
        out.append\(ln\)
        continue
    stripped = ln.lstrip\(" "\)
    out.append\("    " * 8 + stripped if False else ln\)
# simpler: add 4 spaces to every non-empty line in the block except keep as-is? no.
# Actually we want to +4 indent every non-empty line from 'ScheduleDashboardRow\(' through '.id\(record.id\)'
out = [\("    " + ln if ln.strip\(\) else ln\) for ln in block]
lines[start:end] = out
open\(path, "w"\).write\("\\n".join\(lines\)\)
print\("done"\)
EOF)

import re, pathlib

root = pathlib.Path\('/Users/mozheng/projects/Sage-project/Sage/Sage'\)
pattern = re.compile\(r'^\(.*\\.sageMicro\\\(.*\\\)\)\\\)\\s*$'\)
fixed = 0
for path in root.rglob\('*.swift'\):
    text = path.read_text\(\)
    lines = text.split\('\\n'\)
    changed = False
    for i, line in enumerate\(lines\):
        m = pattern.match\(line\)
        if m:
            lines[i] = m.group\(1\)
            changed = True
            fixed += 1
    if changed:
        path.write_text\('\\n'.join\(lines\)\)
print\(f'fixed {fixed} lines'\)
EOF)
